ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, legal representatives, senior managers, authorized signatories, and material counterparties of the WFOE must be screened against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List and sectoral sanctions lists, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, China's Ministry of Public Security restricted lists, PBOC AML/CFT alert databases, and the domestic and cross-strait politically exposed persons (PEP) registers. Enhanced due diligence with source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification, adverse media review, and beneficial-ownership chain reconstruction is mandatory for all PEPs, their family members, and close associates. Screening must occur before incorporation filing, at bank account opening, and on a rolling 180-day interval. Any true positive, OFAC/UN hit, or material discrepancy must be escalated to the AML/CFT compliance officer, reported under PBOC Order No. 3, and cleared before any statutory filing, capital contribution, or bank facility.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR Enterprise Name Pre-approval and Registration Portal / National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, operated by the State Administration for Market Regulation and local Market Supervision Administration one-stop windows
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate name of a China WFOE must be in simplified Chinese characters and follow the four-tier naming convention: administrative division + distinctive name + industry or activity + organization form (limited liability company). An English name may be filed as a secondary name for customs, banking, and trade purposes, but it cannot replace the Chinese statutory name. Any English or phonetic transliteration must correspond consistently to the Chinese distinctive element and must not create confusion with an existing registered mark. Tokens implying state authority, public benefit, or regulated financial activity require ministerial approval or are prohibited outright.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Before the initial 30-day name reservation expires, the applicant may submit an extension request through the SAMR portal in localities that permit one 30-day extension, or re-file the same name if no conflict exists. If the name is rejected, the applicant must obtain a written rejection notice stating the legal grounds. Within the statutory administrative reconsideration window, normally 60 days, the applicant may petition the superior Market Supervision Administration for reconsideration; alternatively, within 6 months the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit before the competent People's Court. The appeal should attach corrected four-tier name alternatives, evidence of non-conflict with prior registrations, and any ministerial consents for sensitive tokens. A parallel fresh name reservation is prudent to protect the incorporation timeline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For this manufacturing WFOE engaged in ISIC 3091 electric cargo e-bike production, a virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible as the sole registered office. SAMR requires the registered address to correspond to actual business premises with manufacturing, warehousing, and operational capacity. Municipal tax authorities require a physical place of business for VAT registration, invoice issuance, and export refund verification, and banks conducting CDD will reject a mailbox-only address for account opening. A correspondence or registered-agent address may be used solely for service of process only while the physical factory address remains the registered office. The entity must secure an industrial factory lease of at least 36 months and maintain full commercial substance documentation before filing.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified likelihood: 70% within the first 12 months. Checklist: verify registered address matches the factory lease; maintain original lease, utility bills, payroll, and social insurance records; display the company nameplate; keep physical inventory of e-bikes, motors, batteries, and controllers; confirm environmental and product safety compliance; and make legal representative and finance manager available for on-site questions. Higher-risk triggers include mismatched address, zero production staff, paper-only transactions, large export refund claims, frequent share transfers, and inadequate evidence of physical operations.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (Republic of China), Articles 128, 129, 131, 154, 156, 172, 387 and 413; Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals, Articles 4, 6 and 12
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Services (MOEA, 經濟部商業發展署) together with the Investment Commission for foreign investment approval
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation and Application for Company Establishment Registration (公司設立登記申請書)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Taiwan Company Act. For foreign-invested entities, the subscribed capital must be fully deposited into a Taiwan NT$ bank escrow account and verified by a Taiwan-licensed CPA before establishment registration; capital verification report is mandatory.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporators approve the Articles of Incorporation of the Taiwan wholly foreign-owned limited company, adopt the registered office address as stated in the Articles, and ratify the subscription of all initial ordinary shares by the sole foreign corporate shareholder. RESOLVED, that the foreign investment approval application be submitted to the Investment Commission, and that the CPA capital verification be completed before any company registration filing. RESOLVED, that the initial directors authorize the appointment of [Name] as General Manager and [Name] as Chief Financial Officer, with full authority to execute registration forms, open bank accounts, apply for factory licenses, and sign all regulatory filings. RESOLVED, that counsel is authorized to notarize and attest required corporate documents. Approved this day, [Date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Business Scope Pre-Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval Online System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an online name reservation application with the proposed English and Chinese name of the Taiwan subsidiary, the intended business scope, and the shareholder identification particulars. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing Taiwanese company. After approval, reserve the name for six months and proceed to foreign investment approval.
required_dossiers: Company name reservation application form
Proposed Chinese and English company names
Intended business scope description
Identification documents of the sole foreign corporate shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, promptly submit a secondary proposed name for re-review; if the business scope is unclear, amend the scope description and resubmit via the same portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (投審會)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the foreign investment application together with audited financial statements of the parent, a capital remittance plan, proposed factory site documents, and a description of the electric cargo e-bike manufacturing operations. The Investment Commission will review the proposed shareholder structure, capital amount, and compliance with FDI regulations and issue an investment approval letter.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Application Form
Parent company certificate of incorporation and board resolution
Audited financial statements of the parent for the latest three years
Power of attorney of the Taiwan authorized representative
Lease or intent-to-lease of the registered office and factory
Detailed investment project and manufacturing plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond to the written deficiency list by submitting supplementary financial evidence, revised capital remittance timeline, or clarification of ultimate beneficial ownership within twenty days; a written appeal can be filed if the investment approval is denied.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Remittance and CPA Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated foreign currency bank and Taiwan-licensed CPA; Central Bank of Taiwan foreign exchange reporting
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the foreign investment approval, remit subscribed capital from the foreign shareholder to a temporary NT$ escrow bank account in Taiwan under the investor's name. Upon receipt, instruct the bank to issue a certificate of foreign exchange settlement and hire a Taiwan-licensed CPA to conduct capital verification and issue a Capital Verification Report.
required_dossiers: Foreign investment approval letter
Foreign exchange remittance instrument
Bank deposit certificate for the paid-up capital
CPA capital verification report
Declaration of no capital recycling or offsetting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the foreign exchange declaration is deficient, file a corrective declaration with the Central Bank through the bank; if the CPA issues a qualified opinion, rectify the capital source documentary chain and deliver an updated confirmation before proceeding.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commercial Services / Taiwan One-Stop Company Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the application for company establishment registration, including the Articles of Incorporation, the Investment Commission approval, the CPA capital verification report, and the directors' meeting records. After the examination is completed, the company receives a Company Registration Certificate (公司登記證明書) and a unified business number (統一編號).
required_dossiers: Company establishment registration application form
Articles of Incorporation
Investment Commission approval letter
CPA capital verification report
Letter of consent of the appointed directors
Proof of registered office address
Power of attorney for the applicant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a correction notice, cure the specified omissions within fifteen days; if the registration is rejected, file an administrative appeal with MOEA within thirty days of the written decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Labor and Social Insurance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance; Bureau of Labor Insurance; Health and Welfare NHIA
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the company registration certificate, file for a tax registration with the local National Taxation Bureau, register as a Goods and Services taxpayer, sign up for a corporate seal card, and complete employer registration with the Bureau of Labor Insurance and National Health Insurance Agency. The tax registration certificate or e-verification code is used for invoicing and import-export rituals.
required_dossiers: Company registration certificate
Unified business number
Corporate seal card and company chop
Director and officer identification
Confirmation of registered office address
Employer registration forms for labor insurance and NHIA
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority or insurance agency issues a data descrepancy notice, correct the filing with supporting corporate documents and resubmit electronically; any late registration penalty can be mitigated by voluntary rectification before audit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Factory Establishment Readiness and Industrial Licensing Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Industrial Development Bureau, MOEA; local municipal government construction and factory administration units
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the factory site in compliance with the Factory Management Act, complete the factory establishment notification and land use conformity review, and submit the application for factory registration at the local factory administration unit once the plant is physically ready. The factory registration examination includes building readiness, production equipment, pollution prevention facilities, and safety compliance for the electric cargo e-bike manufacturing line.
required_dossiers: Factory registration application form
Land ownership or lease certificate and consent letter
Building use permit and structural safety inspection report
Production equipment and manufacturing process description
Pollution control facility plan or EIA-related decision
Fire safety equipment checklist
Occupational safety and health self-inspection form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the factory administration authority issues a defect list, complete the physical improvements and resubmit photographs and a rectification statement within thirty days; if the registration is denied, request administrative reconsideration or re-application with a revised plan.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Bureau, Ministry of Economic Affairs (Taiwan); local municipal factory administration authority
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Factory Registration Certificate (工廠登記證) required for manufacturing operations under the Factory Management Act

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, Executive Yuan (formerly Environmental Protection Administration, Taiwan)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – Exempt / Self-Declaration Registration for light electric bicycle assembly and low-temp paint/battery charging operations, unless the site exceeds 100 m³/day of wastewater discharge or is located in a sensitive environmental district; if triggered, a Full Environmental Impact Assessment Report or an Environmental Impact Statement shall be required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits under Taiwan Effluent Standards: COD ≤ 100 mg/L, SS ≤ 30 mg/L, pH 6-9; VOC operations require compliance with Taiwan Air Pollution Control Act capture efficiency and control efficiency standards (target ≥ 70% for painting lines); industrial waste handling must follow Waste Disposal Act manifesting and cradle-to-grave tracking; battery waste and lithium-ion cells must be handled through a licensed waste disposal system.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification under the Fire Services Act issued by the local fire authority; building structure load inspection and plant safety clearance under the Building Act; occupational safety and health workplace clearance required by the Ministry of Labor including machine guarding, ventilation, electrical safety, and emergency evacuation plans before the factory may commence commercial production.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (国家税务总局, STA) of the People's Republic of China; official national portal: http://www.chinatax.gov.cn; electronic tax filing portal: https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn (provincial e-tax bureaus).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: After the WFOE is incorporated with the Administration for Market Regulation and receives its Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), it must complete tax registration at the competent local STA office within 30 calendar days. The registration packet must include the business license, articles of association, legal representative identification, registered address proof, financial accounting system description, banking account information, and completed tax registration forms. The USCC serves as the entity's taxpayer identification number for enterprise income tax, VAT, and customs declaration purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, pass-through, or hybrid classification election is available to a PRC WFOE; resident enterprises are taxed at entity level on worldwide income. A VAT general taxpayer election is available after annual taxable sales reach RMB 5,000,000 or voluntarily for businesses meeting accounting requirements. Hybrid mismatch and treaty override outcomes are governed by the STA's general anti-avoidance rules implementing BEPS Action 2.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 annual taxable sales for mandatory registration as a general VAT taxpayer; all enterprises with taxable activities, irrespective of turnover, must complete tax registration and obtain a VAT taxpayer identification number.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The PRC operates the Golden Tax System (金税工程) with mandatory near-real-time VAT invoice data transmission to the STA. Comprehensive digital e-invoicing (全电发票) is being rolled out nationally, and all VAT general taxpayers must issue invoices through STA-approved digital invoice platforms with live API/network integration. There is no physical fiscal stamping; each invoice is centrally verified and recorded by the STA.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exports by a VAT general taxpayer are zero-rated for VAT when the sale is a genuine cross-border transaction, title and risk pass to an overseas buyer, the goods physically leave PRC customs territory, and the export declaration is duly logged in the customs system. Electric cargo e-bikes classified under ISIC 3091 qualify for the 0% export rate and corresponding export drawback, subject to the statutory documentation and foreign-exchange repatriation requirements.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (出口货物报关单) with customs endorsement
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (提运单) evidencing physical export
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank foreign-exchange collection receipt (银行收汇凭证)
Foreign trade contract and signed sales order
Packing list and cargo weight manifest
Certificate of Origin when preferential customs treatment is claimed
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: False export zero-rating claims trigger retrospective clawback of all VAT refunded, plus late-payment surcharges and fines from 50% to 300% of the amount fraudulently refunded under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection. Persistent or serious violations may result in suspension of export-rebate qualification, customs penalties, referral to public security for tax evasion or smuggling crime, and inclusion in the STA's serious-tax-credit-violation blacklist with cross-border information exchange.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China for the Chinese WFOE entity; Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) for the Taiwanese parent jurisdiction
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Chinese WFOE operates under partial capital account convertibility with SAFE approval required for most capital transactions and profit remittances to the foreign parent in Taiwan. Current account items such as trade settlements are generally convertible subject to repatriation and reporting obligations. Profit remittance to Taiwan is subject to SAFE review, potential withholding taxes, and documentation of legitimate business expenses, with typical approval timelines of 30-60 days depending on transaction size and compliance history.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export receipts must be surrendered to the designated foreign exchange bank within five working days of receipt. Mandatory conversion to RMB at the prevailing exchange rate is required with 100% surrender of export proceeds. Failure to comply can result in penalties and restrictions on future export activities. For cross-border trade with Taiwan, additional reporting to both SAFE and Taiwanese authorities is mandatory.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium to High. Offshore digital EMIs are permissible but subject to stringent Chinese AML/KYC standards, SAFE cross-border transfer reporting, and potential restrictions on digital payment platforms. Legal constraints include mandatory registration of cross-border payment information and prohibition on using unlicensed fintech for FX transactions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote KYC and account opening is generally permitted for WFOE clients in China provided all required documents are submitted electronically. However, for high-value accounts or if the bank deems it necessary, physical presence of directors or authorized signatories may be required for in-person KYC interviews. Remote opening is standard for standard WFOE onboarding with proper legal representation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds from Taiwan not clearly linked to legitimate business operations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business registration certificate, parent company incorporation documents from Taiwan, audited financial statements, and detailed explanation of capital injection purpose

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual volume of inbound wires without corresponding trade activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Trade contracts, invoices, and proof of goods shipment to substantiate the transaction

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire transfer protocols utilize SWIFT MT103 messages with purpose code 'Capital Contribution' or 'Equity Injection'. Verification involves bank confirmation of the Taiwanese parent company's credentials, SAFE filing of the capital increase, and subsequent reporting to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange within the required timeframe. All inbound funds must be accompanied by a clear purpose code and supporting documentation to avoid classification as illegal capital inflow.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements include SWIFT MT103 for direct wire transfers and Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) issued through correspondent banks. For exports to Taiwan, the process requires export declaration to customs, FX surrender to the bank, and subsequent release of funds. Outbound payments to Taiwan must comply with SAFE regulations on foreign exchange payments, including prior approval for certain large amounts and documentation of underlying trade transactions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward contracts for hedging currency exposure
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for offshore RMB hedging
Currency swaps with licensed Chinese banks to manage liquidity and FX risk

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 30 June for the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Enterprises not filing by 30 June are added to the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations; if unremedied for three consecutive years, inclusion in the List of Serious Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprises follows, with possible administrative fines up to RMB 100,000.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System; data shared with SAMR
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 30 June for the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Warning and order to rectify; continuing failure to report may incur a fine of RMB 100,000 to RMB 500,000 under the Foreign Investment Law of the People’s Republic of China.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (local tax bureau for the WFOE’s registered address)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May in the year following the calendar fiscal year end (31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty up to RMB 10,000 per return; overdue tax accrues a daily surcharge of 0.05%; deliberate understatement may trigger administrative fines from 50% to 500% of underpaid tax.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory audit applies to every WFOE limited liability company at each fiscal year end under Article 164 of the PRC Company Law; there is no turnover or asset threshold exemption for foreign-invested enterprises.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS), as administered by the Ministry of Finance and required for all foreign-invested companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Beneficial ownership and actual controller information must be confirmed annually through the Foreign Investment Information Annual Report by 30 June; any shareholding transfer or actual controller change must be reported to SAMR within the registration filing period and the internal Register of Members must be updated simultaneously.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory 12% Alternative Minimum Tax (Basic Income Tax) on the excess of basic income over the NT$ 500,000 corporate exemption; 5% surtax on unappropriated retained earnings (Article 66-9); R&D investment credits of 15% (capped at 30% of tax payable) under the Statute for Industrial Innovation; 10-year loss carryforward; no general tax holiday remains in force for OEM manufacturing.
